testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/plp/verify-wishlist-detail-for-retail-user-on-quick-view-for-group-product.spec.ts > PLP - Wishlist Detail for Retail User from Quick View (Group Product) > verify wishlist detail for retail user on quick view for group product

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in with the test's own account, clears the wishlist, searches a grouped product by SKU and checks its PLP card, adds it to the wishlist from the grouped Quick View (toast), finds it on the Wishlist page, searches again and removes it from the wishlist from Quick View (toast).
steps: Guest context; open the webstore, sign in from the header with username/password; check the greeting contains 'Hello,'.
Clear the wishlist; search the grouped SKU; check the PLP card name, SKU (divProductSKUContainer408) and sales price (spnSalesPrice408).
Open the grouped Quick View and click the wishlist heart; check the 'added' toast.
Open the Wishlist page; check the product link with the grouped product name is visible.
Search the SKU again and repeat the PLP card checks.
Open the grouped Quick View and click the heart again; check the 'removed' toast. afterEach clears the wishlist.
stateChanges: The declared account's wishlist is cleared at start (and in afterEach), the product is added from Quick View and removed again (wishlist ends empty).
assertions: PLP card shows the grouped product name, SKU and sales price '$500.00' (twice).
Toast 'Product added to your Wishlist.'; Wishlist page lists the grouped product name.
evidence: Title 'verify wishlist detail for retail user on quick view for group product' and step labels 0) to 5) match the flow; no linked cases.

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec opts out of the shared session (test.use storageState empty) and signs in from the header with username/password from its own JSON (credential sources, masked in the scan, profile SENSITIVE). USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED preferred.required true on the username source; the migrated test declares it with testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before signing in.
